QC29 Per quale tra questi motivi lavora part time (a tempo parziale):

assessments.reasoning: Economic maintenance: The survey identifies employment status and paid work (QB01), but does not record income amounts or monetary support by member across all sources (wages, pensions, informal work, remittances). Labor burden: While the survey measures hours in paid work (QC32), it only collects qualitative reasons for working part-time or not seeking employment regarding family care (QC29), and does not record hours spent on unpaid domestic or care work. Property and asset control: The questionnaire asks about ownership of work-related tools (QC18), but does not collect data on dwelling tenure, land, or general asset ownership at member level. Decision-making: The survey asks about autonomy regarding working hours (QC45), but contains no questions on household decision-making spheres (such as child-rearing, daily consumption, or major financial choices).
